map.复合配料何时展开？: When must compound ingredients be expanded?
map.当复合配料加入量>25% 且国标另列其原始配料时须展开，否则可整体标示。: When a compound ingredient is added at more than 25% and the national standard sets out its original components separately, it must be expanded; otherwise it may be declared as a whole.
map.添加量相同怎么办？: What if two amounts are the same?
map.质量相近者可并列，按习惯或功能排序；以投料记录为准。: Ingredients of similar mass may be listed side by side, ordered by custom or function; the production record governs.
